selection: Per training seed: best.pt by mean total reward on the fixed validation seeds. No selection by test or by best training seed.
replication_scope: Three optimizer/network/exploration/replay seeds on the same declared training scenario schedule. This does not establish robustness to other maps, hardware or hyperparameters.
presentation: Four DRL configurations plus two heuristic labels. Retain individual trained models as replicates, not separate algorithms.
statistics: Equal weighting of training seeds and scenario seeds. Crossed bootstrap resamples paired training-seed indices and paired scenario indices separately. Three training seeds yield exploratory uncertainty estimates. Never count heuristic copies as independent observations.
